model_equation: gain * (stimulus dot unit-normalized isotropic Gaussian(x,y,sigma))^exponent, convolved with HRF plus polynomial baseline terms

polar_angle_convention.range: 0–360; angle is NaN when fitted eccentricity is exactly zero
polar_angle_convention.rotation: 90 degrees is upper vertical meridian (+y); angles increase counterclockwise in x-right/y-up coordinates
polar_angle_convention.hemisphere_convention: same raw convention for both hemispheres; left-hemisphere color-map reflection in plotting code is visualization-only
polar_angle_convention.official_source: analyzePRF.m output documentation and nsddatapaper PARAMETERSnotes.m

size.semantics: CSS effective pRF size = Gaussian sigma / sqrt(exponent); this is not raw Gaussian sigma

quality.semantics: training R² after projecting polynomials from data and fit
quality.range: generally 0–100 but can be negative; values below -1000 are capped to -1000 in release

invalid_policy: NaN or documented release cap sentinels remain invalid; no imputation
